China.text: Shanghai, not the capital Beijing, is its most populous city by urban area.
China.evidence: Beijing is the capital, while Shanghai is the most populous city by urban area.

United States.text: British colonization, beginning in 1607, established the Thirteen Colonies.
United States.evidence: Beginning in 1607, British colonization established the Thirteen Colonies.

India.text: Settled life emerged in the Indus river basin 9,000 years ago, later becoming the Indus Valley Civilisation.
India.evidence: Settled life emerged in the western margins of the Indus river basin 9,000 years ago, evolving into the Indus Valley Civilisation of the third millennium BCE.

Russia.text: The 1917 Revolution created the Russian SFSR, the first socialist state.
Russia.evidence: The Russian Revolution of 1917 led to the abolition of the Russian monarchy and the creation of the Russian SFSR, the first socialist state.

Japan.text: Around 75% of its terrain is mountainous and heavily forested.
Japan.evidence: Japan is divided into 47 administrative prefectures and eight traditional regions, and around 75% of its terrain is mountainous and heavily forested,

Iran.text: An attempt to nationalize its oil industry led to the Anglo-American coup in 1953.
Iran.evidence: Attempts by Mohammad Mosaddegh to nationalize the oil industry led to the Anglo-American coup in 1953.

Indonesia.text: European powers competed to monopolise trade in its Spice Islands of Maluku.
Indonesia.evidence: European powers later competed to monopolise trade in the Spice Islands of Maluku during the Age of Discovery.

Saudi Arabia.text: Home to Mecca and Medina, the two holiest cities in Islam.
Saudi Arabia.evidence: Riyadh is the capital and largest city, while other major centers include Jeddah and the two holiest cities in Islam, Mecca and Medina.

Germany.text: Northern German regions were the centre of the Protestant Reformation in the 16th century.
Germany.evidence: During the 16th century, northern German regions became the centre of the Protestant Reformation.

Canada.text: It is officially bilingual, in English and French, at the federal level.
Canada.evidence: The country is a Commonwealth realm and is officially bilingual (English and French) in the federal jurisdiction.
